title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Ampitheater on 1982-10-09

ai_review.summary: An excellent, best‑sounding soundboard capture of a wonderful Dead show.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the audio quality, calling it the best‑sounding copy on the Internet Archive and describing it as incredible. Although no specific songs are mentioned, they refer to the performance as a "wonderful" show, indicating strong overall enjoyment.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high 5‑star ratings and enthusiastic comments about both the sound quality and the show suggest a top‑tier recording of a solid performance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe it as the best‑sounding copy, with an 'incredible' and 'lovely' sound; no issues noted.
